title: Gender Biases in Automatic Evaluation Metrics for Image Captioning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating automatic image captioning metrics (e.g., CLIPScore, CIDEr) on a newly curated dataset (PAO-EVALBIAS) by measuring their accuracy in differentiating correct versus incorrect gender captions across images of men and women engaged in various professions, activities, and with specific objects. The paper also measures gender prediction errors in captions generated by models optimized with these metrics via reinforcement learning.
